discrepancies.finding: Voice guide and installer described Chatterbox as the only supported provider.
discrepancies.resolution: Document embedded Chatterbox and external Crane; correct installer copy.

discrepancies.finding: Blanket config restart instruction and fresh conversation advice concealed cached singleton reuse.
discrepancies.resolution: Use revisioned desired/active config, explain model release, and coordinate any necessary restart.

discrepancies.finding: One-shot HTTP route was labeled test-only transcription and omitted translation/provider selection.
discrepancies.resolution: Document multipart capability/provider/model/language/prompt, result metadata, upload/error behavior, local Whisper versus compatible bindings and external recording delivery.

discrepancies.finding: Vocabulary guide omitted desired-versus-active semantics and implied clear only removed custom additions.
discrepancies.resolution: Explain revision-checked desired mutations, active listing, seeded-term clearing and preserved base prompt.

discrepancies.finding: Readiness prose treated all enabled models as always requested and omitted the status-request message.
discrepancies.resolution: Document request-scoped status and distinguish want_stt/want_tts from voice_prepare stt_enabled/tts_enabled.

discrepancies.finding: Crane guide assumed a machine-local launcher, private saved trial, universal 2 MiB service limit and external inference cancellation timing.
discrepancies.resolution: Generalize operator-owned setup and snapshots, require checking the installed external service limit, and limit cancellation claims to closing the HTTP stream.

discrepancies.finding: Voice guide instructed holding the toolbar microphone and omitted latched primary-button recording.
discrepancies.resolution: Distinguish mode switch from primary record button, document hold/release, tap latch, keyboard and cancellation.

discrepancies.finding: WebSocket errors directed users to removed Settings > Voice and pip install; installer linked nonexistent YouTube sampling instructions.
discrepancies.resolution: Correct recovery to gobby install voice and uv sync on daemon host; link reference requirements. Parameterized regression verifies disabled/missing-runtime recovery and request identity.

discrepancies.finding: Touched warmup tests reported 59 pre-existing typing errors from untyped mutable test-host callbacks and mock inspection.
discrepancies.resolution: Explicitly type replaceable callbacks and mock host fields, and narrow optional await_args. Final scoped type audit has zero errors. No suppressions or relaxed checker configuration.
